lead_raw_text:
The structure of CaAg3Ir2 (Ca2Ag6Ir4 per cell) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with 12 atoms distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag centers with 12 geometric neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Ca and Ir centers adopt 16- and 14-neighbor environments, respectively. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing between Ag and Ir polyhedra, and corner sharing between Ag and Ca polyhedra.
